passive.name: Mana Surge
passive.text: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Arcanopulse
spells.text: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

spells.name: Eye of Destruction
spells.text: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.

spells.name: Shocking Orb
spells.text: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

spells.name: Rite of the Arcane
spells.text: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.

damage.value: Xerath deals burst magic damage with his damaging abilities.

archetype.value: Xerath is a mage who attacks from long range with spells.

axis.value: Xerath plays for long-range poke with Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction.

bait.why: After Xerath spends Shocking Orb, its stun is unavailable until the cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Xerath misses Eye of Destruction’s extra damage and stronger slow when he fails to hit with its center.
